verdict.rationale: The gov.uk pages point to public trade-mark lookups: search by trade mark number or owner, a "Track a trade mark" service, and the weekly online trade marks journal listing recently accepted applications, which together suggest a founder can check a trade mark filing's status. The evidence is only link titles and short mentions, though, and nothing covers checking the status of a patent or design application. missing for 10: documented detail of what status information the trade mark tracker shows, any patent or design application status lookup, hands-on confirmation of the search host's status pages (the probe only reached robots.txt).
